single_outlet_findings.finding: The only outlet to make Rubio's media rebuke the headline — centering on press access to diplomatic details rather than the substance of the Lavrov meeting or Ukraine/Iran policy outcomes.
The only outlet to headline explicit pessimism — 'No Breakthroughs, Little Optimism' — while every other bucket framed the Lavrov talks in neutral procedural or cautiously optimistic terms.

The only outlet to reference the 'dead Anchorage plan' in the headline, surfacing a specific failed bilateral initiative not named elsewhere and reframing the meeting as US-Russia normalization rather than Ukraine peace mediation.

bottom_line: Headline coverage packages Rubio's ASEAN tour as guarded dual-track US foreign policy: cautious Ukraine peace engagement with no deal imminent, and simultaneous Iran strikes paired with open-door negotiation rhetoric.
